title: Factorized layer x task representation code
hypothesis: A per-layer two-angle Mirror View applied to a per-task code recovers held-out layer-task interventions with lower actual serialized bytes than independent pair codes, while matching generic layer-matrix x task-code factorization.
physical_object: Shared fixed synthetic 64x4 orthonormal intervention basis
mirror_coordinate: Per-layer Givens angles on planes (0,1) and (2,3), composed with a per-task rank-4 code
logical_multiplicity: 8 layers x 32 task interventions; held-out layer-task combinations
controls: Direct LoReFT basis plus per-layer-task rank-4 coefficient table
One shared LoReFT task code reused across layers
Generic full 4x4 layer matrix x rank-4 task code
Mirror Givens layer View x rank-4 task code

task.target: c[l,t] = R(theta_l) z[t] + rho*e[l,t]; y[l,t] = B c[l,t]
task.holdout: Deterministic 20% layer-task pairs; every layer and task appears in training

development.allowed: Select common optimizer steps from {400,800,1200}; no other architecture or hyperparameter selection.

paid_objects: layer View angles or layer matrices

success_gate: At rho=0, every fresh world has held-out NRMSE <=0.05, Mirror actual bytes <=80% of direct LoReFT coefficient-table bytes, and Mirror lies on a useful quality/byte Pareto point against shared-task tying and generic full-matrix factorization.
failure_gate: Held-out quality or byte gate fails, or a simpler control matches quality at equal/fewer actual bytes.

amendment_A1.reason: Code review found that initial decode timing measured only basis application and omitted generation of coefficients from stored factor/angle codes.
amendment_A1.change: End-to-end decode timing now includes factor/View coefficient generation plus shared-basis application. No quality, storage, optimizer-step, or model-selection rule changes.
amendment_A1.fresh_rerun: Repeat the same locked worlds/seeds/settings; preserve initial runtime records as exploratory A0 and use A1 for runtime conclusions.

boundaries: Synthetic frozen representation screen only; shared basis is known by construction.
rho=0.1 maps private-residual need and is not a required pass condition.
No pretrained Transformer, language, capacity, or independent-capacity claim.
